TermTranslation.definition: Blood that is hidden or invisible to the eye.

TermTranslation.term: âkâ nûkuhch mihkw mikw ayâpich â ihtikuhch
TermTranslation.term_syllabics: ᐋᑳ ᓅᑯᐦᒡ ᒥᐦᒄ ᒥᒄ ᐊᔮᐱᒡ ᐋ ᐃᐦᑎᑯᐦᒡ
TermTranslation.public_note_en: blood that isn’t seen but is still there

TermTranslation.term: ekâ nûkuhch mihkw mikw ayâpach e ihtakuhch
TermTranslation.term_syllabics: ᐁᑳ ᓅᑯᐦᒡ ᒥᐦᒄ ᒥᒄ ᐊᔮᐸᒡ ᐁ ᐃᐦᑕᑯᐦᒡ
TermTranslation.public_note_en: blood that isn’t seen but is still there
